## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- Standard single-day filter (most common)
WHERE grass_date = date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
  AND grass_region IN ('ID','MY','PH','SG','TH','TW','VN','BR')

-- Date range filter (for 7-day aggregation)
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN DATE('${PREV_7D}') AND DATE('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')

-- Single region filter
WHERE grass_date = date'${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
  AND grass_region IN ('SG')
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- Pattern 1: LEFT JOIN on (grass_region, grass_date) — most common
LEFT JOIN mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live ex
    ON b.grass_region = ex.grass_region
    AND b.grass_date = ex.grass_date

-- Pattern 2: JOIN on grass_region only (single-date subquery)
JOIN (
    SELECT grass_region, exchange_rate
    FROM mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = date'${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
) e ON r.grass_region = e.grass_region

-- Pattern 3: JOIN on (grass_date, grass_region) with BROADCAST hint
JOIN (
    SELECT /*+ BROADCAST */
        grass_date, grass_region, exchange_rate
    FROM mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE('${ISO_YESTERDAY}')
) ...

-- Pattern 4: JOIN on grass_date + grass_region for cost conversion
JOIN (
    SELECT grass_region, grass_date, exchange_rate AS exchange
    FROM mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live
) B ON A.grass_date = B.grass_date AND A.grass_region = B.grass_region
```

### Snippet 1: USD to Local Currency Conversion (Budget)
```sql
-- Source: data_paidadsmart/scheduled_tasks/xiaochen/ads_bidding_target2_campaign_performance_nd
SELECT
    SUM(COALESCE(b.campaign_valid_budget_usd * ex.exchange_rate, 0.0)) AS campaign_valid_budget_amt_7d
FROM mp_paidads.ads_campaign_valid_budget_1d__reg_s0_live b
LEFT JOIN mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live ex
    ON b.grass_region = ex.grass_region
    AND b.grass_date = ex.grass_date
WHERE b.tz_type = 'local'
    AND b.grass_date BETWEEN DATE('${PREV_7D}') AND DATE('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
```

### Snippet 2: Local Cost to USD Conversion (CPM/Revenue)

    SUM(COALESCE(expenditure_amt_local, 0.0) / exchange) AS cost,
    SUM(COALESCE(expenditure_amt_local, 0.0) / exchange) / (SUM(COALESCE(impression_cnt, 0.0)) + 1.0) * 1000 AS cpm
FROM ... A
JOIN (
    SELECT grass_region, grass_date, exchange_rate AS exchange
    FROM mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live
) B ON A.grass_date = B.grass_date AND A.grass_region = B.grass_region

### Snippet 5: PGMV/PADVV Local to USD Conversion in Bidding
```sql
-- Source: mkplpaidads_search_ads/workflows/ads_algo/bidding/perf_predictor/common_daily
SELECT
    round(pgmv / exchange_rate, 6) as pgmv_usd,
    round(padvv / exchange_rate, 6) as padvv_usd
FROM ads_perf a
JOIN (
    SELECT * FROM mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = date('${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME, "yyyy-MM-dd", "-1d")}')
    AND grass_region IN ('BR','ID','SG','TH','VN','PH','TW','MY')
) b ON a.grass_date = b.grass_date AND a.grass_region = b.grass_region
```
